name: H2a: Remove LayerNorm from CLN (FCN3 pattern)
theory: LayerNorm erases condition magnitude (verified: encoder 1.6x norm ratio for turb vs calm, but LN normalizes to unit scale). Removing LN lets magnitude survive to output. FCN3 removes ALL normalization for same reason.
risk: Training instability without normalization. Need He init + LayerScale.

name: H1: AR Frame Generation + CLN + E2E + K=2 (FGN/AIFS pattern)
theory: AR propagates regime step-by-step. Fresh noise per frame. Per-frame loss at D=25 has stronger correlation signal. Old Block-AR had turb/calm=1.46 with AR. FGN/AIFS both use AR.
risk: Error accumulation over 30 AR steps. Slower training (30 forward passes per sample).

name: H3: Variogram Score at D=25 (dualGNN pattern)
theory: afCRPS is marginal-only, blind to correlation. VS directly penalizes pairwise dependency errors. At D=25, dualGNN proved composite outperforms CRPS-only (D=18: 90/10, D=30: 30/70 ES/VS).
risk: VS may overfit pairwise structure to training regime (same as ES in RC18). Need test-split validation.
kill_condition: No lambda gives test corr > 0.85 with test CI > 0.35

name: H4: Direct Output, No Mean/Residual Split (FGN/FCN3 pattern)
theory: FGN has no explicit mean/residual split. FCN3 argues residual limits to Euler steps. Removing split eliminates MSE/afCRPS loss conflict. But Wells Fargo cautions: simple > complex at N~4000.
risk: Model may not learn mean at N~4000 without scaffold. Need warm-up (Stirn 2023).

stages.desc: Direct output + E2E + warm-up (20ep freeze noise), 80ep
